items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: Sam Taylor was in the band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he was a real strong fellow.

Yeah. He was doing pushups. And I see all these old black musicians. And like I’m this wimpy white guy. But it was a fantastic experience. Eddie became very helpful to me. He became like a bit of a mentor. And the lead alto player, his name was George Dorsey, who has the most beautiful sound, he was wonderful. Sam Taylor was in the band.
